title: Flatten a Multilevel Doubly Linked List
goal: Solve Flatten a Multilevel Doubly Linked List: Splice a child list immediately after its parent while preserving the deferred next chain and all backward links.
strategy: Splice a child list immediately after its parent while preserving the deferred next chain and all backward links.
edgeCases: A child chain may itself have children; the old next chain must resume after the entire child subtree.
